text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан, though still pre-debut,
secures a place in the exalted
Sprout
Kinen. It's an amazing accomplishment and
the talk of the
academy.

The exhibition race will be held at the
Tokyo Racecourse, where most
legendary
runners first come to prominence.

I'm sure many are eager with excitement to
see the Beast in action.
However, the
unforeseen happens...

Бива Хаяхидэ is called by student council
president Симболи Рудольф
for an urgent
meeting.
You want me to race on her behalf?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
What... what is the meaning of this,
President?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I understand that this is sudden and a lot
to process. We are just as
thunderstruck as
you are.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But the reality is this... Нарита Брайан has
come down with a fever.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The racer chosen to take her place in the
Sprout Kinen is you. So I ask
again, Biwa
Hayahide, will you heed the call?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This is her chance. If she can race against
top runners in the Sprout
Kinen, it should
help her get closer to completing the
winning
equation.
Knowing that, I encourage her to join.

Impossible. I'm not at that level—Brian's
level.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm no replacement for her!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I disagree. You—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I know her capabilities more than anyone!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I lost my composure.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm worried about Brian's condition. Before
I make any decisions, I
would like to go
see my sister.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Of course. I apologize for not giving due
consideration.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
However... there is, frankly, no time to
spare. I expect your decision
soon.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Hayahide is anxious as we go to check on
Нарита Брайан. At the
hospital, we're told
the ailing racer has just taken some
medicine and
fallen asleЭпизод

She looks terrible. I'm always telling her to
take better care of herself,
but she never
listens...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: It's the exact opposite of before.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: It was a long time ago.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Her physical abilities began to surpass
mine. No longer able to keep
up, I started
training recklessly.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But my sister—even though she was so
young—was worried about me.
And one
day, while we were playing tag...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I should've treated it as a friendly game
between sisters, as a proper
older sibling
would.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
No. No matter how fast I ran, I was unable
to catch up to her. I grew
more and more
desperate, eventually neglecting to watch
where I was
going... I crashed into a fence
and wound up in the hospital.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
While I was completely bedridden, Brian
kept improving her speed on
her own.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't move—all I could do was use
my head. That's when I
began to persist in
my studies.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
In bed, I sank myself into my notes and
books, constructing theories
day in and
day out. I even gave one the grand title of
the "winning
equation."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: But... You know what, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Not once in all this time have I ever been
able to predict Нарита Брайан
and her pure
instincts.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: She always exceeds my calculations. She destroys all my equations. She's an anomaly that I cannot solve!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Her words are filled with suffering... And I
realize she's been holding
this pain inside
the whole time.

No matter how hard she thinks, the Beast
always bests her theories.
But even now,
she pushes on, always planning and
formulating.
choice_data_list: And that's how you gained your unique ability.

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Your theories are an unrivaled force.

text_block_list.text:
I told you, I've never been accurate when
it comes to Brian. No matter
how hard I
try, I'll never surpass her!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I still haven't been able to prove any of my
theories—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: You? How so?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
In tomorrow's race, I'll stay near the lead
until the final corner. The
front pack will
be tightly grouped together.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Following the last turn, I'll pass them from
outside.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Then I will gain a lead of no less than ten
lengths—and place first.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Three... two... one.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Time to confirm my calculations!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I still remember how my chest pounded
with excitement back then.

The way she talked about her calculations
made my heart dance. I
couldn't help but
want to work together and bring her
theories to
fruition!

I was completely captivated by her
brilliant winning equation!
Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
Let's solve your equation and seize
victory—together.

text_block_list.text:
Why? Do you truly believe that I can reach
her level?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: He's not the only one who believes in you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: She's not the only one who believes in you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: President!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There's something of vital importance that
I forgot to tell you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Vital importance?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yes, the one who so strongly
recommended you above all others as

Нарита Брайан's replacement...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: —was Нарита Брайан herself. She said it must be you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ gasps in total shock, but
her expression quickly shifts
to one filled
with determination.
She is ready to do what's necessary.
